DROWNED CREWMATE
CR 3

XP 800
CE Medium undead
Init +0, Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 11, touch 10, flat-footed 11 (+1 natural)
hp 40 (9d8)
Fort +6, Ref +2, Will +7
SQ undead traits

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee slam +9 (1d10 +3)

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 10, Con -, Int 2, Wis 12, Cha 11
Base Atk +6; CMB +8, CMD 18

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Undead Fortitude (Su)

If damage reduces the drowned crewmate to 0 hit points, it must make a Fortitude saving throw with a DC of 5+ the damage taken, unless the damage is from positive energy, holy damage, or from a critical hit. On a success, the drowned crewmate drops to 1 hit point instead.

Burst (Ex)

When a drowned crewmate dies, it explodes in a 5-foot radius for 3d6 poi s on damage. A Fortitude save DC 14 will half the damage.

Underwater Mobility (Ex)

Drowned crewmates are unaffected by the rules of fighting underwater.
